preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= o1 <= 10**4 for o1 in o1_values)
preconditions.description: Each o1 value is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= o2 <= 10**2 for o2 in o2_values)
preconditions.description: Each o2 value is between 1 and 10^2.

preconditions.expression: all(o1 * o2 <= 10**6 for o1, o2 in zip(o1_values, o2_values))
preconditions.description: The product of o1 and o2 for each test case does not exceed 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(d in [0, 1] for d in district_representatives)
preconditions.description: Each district representative is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in [0, 1] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 1 if any(sum(district_representatives[j:j+o2]) > o2 // 2 for j in range(i * o1 * o2, (i + 1) * o1 * o2, o2)) else 0
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 1 if there exists a partition of the districts into states such that the majority of the state governors are Ones; otherwise, it is 0.
